event: On Day 13, five days left, Wren finds a faint handprint worn into the threshold stone.
The palm-hollow is narrower than hers, worn by decades of the same daily touch.
A healer's hand: someone who said hello each morning to the places she loved.
She sits back on her heels and feels the stone's [Dormant] warmth rise through her boots.
The Prayer-Notch's [Tended] warmth and the healer's house's [Kept] weight are there too.
For the first time she feels all three bonds at once, not one after another.
She had come for a methodical survey toward Known depth before Day 18.
Checking the compass, she finds she has sat at the handprint an hour at least.
She surveys the stone through the morning with a witness's attention.
Under a chipped corner the limestone shows twelve thin dark mineral bands.
The stone predates Varethen by millennia; the settlement was built around it.
A discovery logs the threshold stone's age, discovery 4: +38 XP.

changes.note: Discovery: threshold stone formed about 4,000 years before settlement

event: At midday she eats with her back against the warm threshold stone.
She feels a sub-audible hum: the noon sun sets the stone's crystal lattice vibrating.
The stone has sung at noon unheard for three hundred years; now she is its audience.
A discovery logs the noon resonance, discovery 5: +42 XP.

changes.note: Discovery: threshold stone's noon thermal resonance

event: She eats a flatcake and feels the stone's patience as something more like fidelity.
In the afternoon she does the arithmetic plainly.
The Shelf and the Eye reached Familiar in about ten and nine discoveries.
The threshold stone is the cluster's anchor; Known depth there must take more.
She lists what she does not know: why the stone is here, what [Dormant] sleeps toward.
She has five discoveries and suspects she needs fifteen: ten more in five days.
Later discoveries come slower; she might do everything right and not make it.
She asks what she has not used yet, and answers herself: the gap.
Hadley finds her at the settlement's edge, carrying Millhaven news.
A runner says Aldric's niece Brecca, fifteen, from Thorngate, is asking after Wren.
Brecca asks if Wren went south, if the track is passable, what a Wayfinder does.
Theron's people would notice if she came south; Hadley will be at Millhaven in two days.
Wren's message: keep her comfortable; the settlement exists; back by Day 20 at the latest.
'Tell her the count says five.' Hadley writes it in his notebook.
She looks at the dead grey tree standing at the apex of the gap in the ghost-elm ward.
'I'm going in.' She will test whether discoveries made holding the bond count more.
'If you're wrong, two hours for nothing.' The needle and the count will tell her.
She crosses into the gap: the air thin, the forest's hum muted, the stone's warmth dim.
At the dead tree the compass needle drags: the gap reads as depleted, nothing to pull.
She reaches for the threshold stone; the bond is dim, like touching it through cloth.
She holds it by effort, the way a lamp needs oil; under compression the stone needs her.
She stops trying to earn the bond and holds it simply because she is here.
The [Dormant] trait stirs for three breaths; something ancient regards her, then settles.
She understands [Dormant] is storage: the stone keeps its oldest self in reserve.
She has seen the sleeper move, and knows it is worth waking.
Working narrowly, she reads the dead tree's spiral bark-stripping as parasitic fungal decay.
The fungus and the corruption came through the same weakness at the same time.
A discovery inside the gap takes a compression multiplier, discovery 6: +55 XP.

changes.note: Discovery in the gap: dead tree's fungal decay, compression multiplier

event: She sits by the dead tree: holding the bond while surveying is rewarded.
The soil differs between the gap's center and its boundary: discovery seven.
The ghost-elms lean to deflect the resonance around the gap: discovery eight.
The compass cannot tell corruption from depletion, itself information: discovery nine.
After three hours she comes back through the ward, tired from listening hard so long.
She sits against the threshold stone, eating, as the bonds recalibrate.
The threshold stone's warmth returns first, then the prayer-notch, then the healer's house.
All three sound at once: a chord, the settlement itself rather than three structures.
She writes 'like hearing a chord instead of three notes', crosses it out, and keeps it.
She walks the terraces for an hour in the gold late light.
Crouched at the second terrace step just before dusk, she feels the bond change quality.
The threshold stone bond deepens to Familiar at nine discoveries: +80 XP.

changes.note: Bond deepened: threshold stone, Glimpsed to Familiar

event: [Dormant] grants nothing until Known; the triad relay transmits at higher fidelity.
She can feel the well's direction and the prayer-notch eight meters northeast.
Familiar will ask more attention to keep; she reaches for the terrace wall's shimmer.
On Day 14 she surveys in the morning and goes into the gap in the afternoon.
She reaches discoveries twelve and thirteen, and stops predicting.
A basin thrush turns back at the dead tree's root-line, marking the suppression radius.
On Day 15, three days left, she sits at the threshold stone before dawn, just to be there.
A thirty-second dawn hum runs through the stone as first light warms its surface.
She does not file it as a discovery; she simply knows the stone at dawn now.
The margin says three; Known depth at an anchor still looks out of reach.
The chance of not making it no longer feels like failure; it feels like information.
She thinks of Brecca at Aldric's inn, asking about the southern tracks.
Wren picks up her pack: she has three days, and she will use all of them.
